params._comment: W7 expansion FLYOVER beat, CUT-EXPANSION reshoot: wide approach diving into a LOW SKIMMING pass over the freshly-written terrain (y offsets bob 9 -> 6.5 -> 11 -> 8: terrain-hugging altitude variation), sweeping laterally along the growth front, then a pull-up into a high wide hold that hands the free camera off already framing the new land (the rift-drop beats open there next). The play anchor is resolved per play via the growth_front dynamic anchor: ExpansionSequence leads RingGrowthService.progressFraction by the wave's real blocks-per-tick AND projects the skim-time keyframe offset onto the radial direction (EVAL-V6-CUTBD defect-4 fix), so the rolling front passes beneath the camera at the skim (t ~0.5) for EVERY watcher angle — the front_cross shake rides that beat (it sat at the pre-fix 'representative' t 0.78, ~60t after the now-guaranteed crossing; REPASS retime). lookAt targets sit at ground level so the wavefront terrain stays in frame regardless of approach angle. In-path shakes stay light on purpose: RingGrowthService's own distance-scaled rumble pulses (growth.shakeEveryRings) ride on top during the whole sweep and ARE the wave-tick-synced rumble. Played as a GLOBAL_TELEPORT group show with returnAfter.
params._doc: Per-keyframe 'fov' (degrees, default 70) is smoothly lerped along the flight by CameraDirector.onComputeFov and eases back into the player's own FOV at the end. Top-level 'showOwnBody' (default false) keeps the watcher's own player model visible — author true only for shots that deliberately frame the watcher.
